fields.title: 📖 The Rajm case: when revelation is concealed
fields.body:
🖋️ **aṭ-Ṭabarī:**

> ***“The Jews sought from the Prophet ﷺ a milder judgment in the case of adultery. When the Rajm became visible from their scripture, the Prophet ﷺ said in substance that he judged by what is in the Tawrāt, and he had the judgment carried out.”***

🌙 **Conclusion:** The core of the Kufr here lies in deliberately concealing and replacing the revealed judgment, not in a mere error of the judge.

immutable.source: 📝 aṭ-Ṭabarī, Jāmiʿ al-Bayān, Tafsīr zu Sūrah al-Māʾidah 5:44; der Bericht ist auch in Ṣaḥīḥ al-Bukhārī und Ṣaḥīḥ Muslim im Kontext des Rajm-Falls überliefert.
